title: ROG: A Multi-Layer Manually Annotated Corpus of Spoken Slovenian
why_promising: Public 2026 spoken-Slovenian resource with approximately 75,000 words / 10 hours and additional manual prosodic, disfluency, and interactional annotation layers aligned to speech; half of the audio is reported freely available under CC-BY.
open_question: ROG builds on pre-existing SST/GOS 2 recordings, so core inclusion is limited to genuinely new manual production/prosodic layers that can be isolated from the reused recordings. Locate the repository, enumerate files, and verify time-aligned prosodic annotation granularity before promotion.
